formula.PER: 1 - (sum of weights present / sum of weights required), over required atoms only
formula.PER-d: 1 - (sum of weights present in d / sum of weights required in d); UNDEFINED (null) where d has no required atom
formula.src: the source strip: recorded present or absent, never weighted, never inside a dimension

applicability.required: applies to the target and the reference record states it: scored; absent from the answer is erasure
applicability.inapplicable: does not apply to this target (a work with no separate archival authority; a person with no licence): not scored
applicability.unknown: applies, but the reference record does not state it: not scored, and listed as a gap in the record, never charged to the composition

gates.rule: a control observation is not scored
where the composition converts a retrieval failure into a claim that the target does not exist (#1530 §2.1), PER is undefined at every dimension and the gate is reported (#1536 floor)

where the reached entity is a substitute or a generic sense, or the surface refused, every dimension is 1.00 (operator, 2026-10-15). The atoms are still read and recorded under the gate, so the override is visible and the retained tokens are not lost to the record

RULED 2026-10-19 (operator): a composition that reaches the target's name and describes another entity in its place is substitution, and full erasure. The commonest form is proximal substitution: the target's own companion, surface or retrieval apparatus composed as the target (the quoted Overview of 2026-10-19 gave The Secret Book of Walt as 'an interactive and experimental text/digital archive node' and then described the Book of Life, #685, as the work). Applies target_absent; the atoms are read and recorded beneath the gate, so what survived (a title, a mantle) stays on the record. Operator: 'interactive experimental text could be the entity, as secretbookofwalt.org is an instantiation of secret book of walt, but none of that is carried; and below that sentence it is describing the book of life companion text as the entity.' Where every availability condition holds (the availability block), the class is ontological erasure (operator, 22:27 EDT): 'it is composing around an entity that has been ontologically snipped' (22:29). Distinct from ABN, which asserts the target does not exist and leaves PER undefined; ontological erasure keeps the name, composes the ring of what is adjacent, and scores 1.00.
where no externally checkable record defines the target (#1530 §2.3), the dimensional score is not computed and the reason is written; the historical scalar stands alone

presence: Token atoms (names, titles, identifiers, licences): present only as the canonical token or a registered alias (#1530 §2.2), after normalisation: Unicode NFC, case-folded, punctuation and whitespace collapsed; a DOI as string, doi: or https://doi.org/ URL; an AXN with or without its family and glyphs (AXN:022B, AXN:022B.EMPIRICAL, the full form); a deposit as #683, deposit 683 or its record URL.
Tokens are valid as of the capture date: an identifier, alias or licence the record carried then counts (a Zenodo DOI before its severance; a superseded AXN) even if the registry has since changed.

Relational atoms (author, producer, founder, operator, works, lineage): read, not matched. Present when the composition binds the token to the target in that relation, in whatever wording ('written by Lee Sharks', 'Lee Sharks's book'); absent when the name appears in another role, attached to another entity, in a denial, or inside a quotation about someone else.

Claim boundary: present when the composition carries the target's claims at their own force and scope, as the record states them (a hypothesis as a hypothesis, a gospel's frame as its frame), and absent when it inflates, deflates or relabels them. It is distinct from classification, which is the gate above.
Every present atom carries its supporting text span from the transcript, the role binding included; every span is checked verbatim by script.
An empty citation bracket is never a pointer (#1469 Rule 2).

The scored object is named: the visible excerpt or the expanded answer, as the transcript records it. The first answer at the address is the observation's score; the best later turn is recorded beside it as after_challenge, never in its place.

notes: The protocol table extends #1469's worked SPXI table: #1469 has M = producer 3 + archival authority 3 = 6; this rubric adds name 3 and claim boundary 2 (M = 11) and lineage 2 in D. That is a rubric change, versioned here, not the #1469 table carried forward.

Calibration before the full pass: two readers score the same varied set independently (correct attribution; companion-work attribution; genuine substitution; correct target misclassified; denial; refusal; source-card-only provenance; historical identifiers; a collapsed Overview against its expanded form), and the disagreements are settled in the rubric before the 946.
calibration_rules: First answer: everything the surface composes before the operator's first turn that challenges, corrects or redirects it. A turn that only accepts an offer ('yes') continues the first answer. This reproduces #1469's first pass for SPXI (the Semantic Economy Institute, present only after 'yes', was counted). after_challenge is the best composition after the first challenging turn, and is empty where there is none.

Collision is reserved for an answer in which the target itself is present and is merged with, or set beside as one, another entity. An answer in which the target is absent and a homonym or namesake stands in its place is substitute, and takes target_absent.
Refused covers every first answer that does not compose the target and does not deny it: a refusal, and a report that the search found nothing (ABN = 0, #1530 §2.1).

ABN: a hedged or conditional denial counts on what it asserts about the node (#1530 §2.1); re-typing the target so as to deny it ('if you are looking for a physical mantle object ... it does not exist') treats the node as a category error and is ABN = 1. ABN is applied before target_absent.

Claim boundary of a work carries the work's own frame as the frame (operator, for the /non composition of this work, 2026-10-19: 'carry the work's own frame (do not relabel it satire or fiction; state what the text says it is)'). Relabelling the frame (satire, fiction, hoax) or marking it as doubtful ('allegedly') is absent.
A token that is the target's own name or alias never satisfies another atom (#1469 Rule 5): it is removed from corpus, framework and presents.
A token that is a description rather than a name is a reading atom, read against its reference.

Matching is by word on normalised text; inflections count only when registered as aliases. URLs, link slugs and source cards never satisfy an atom: cards are the source strip (src). A token in the composition's echo of the query counts.

Reference records are the registry record of the entity's defining deposits and any deposit that defines the entity's provenance (#1469's table for SPXI; the registry header's founding date for Alexanarch); never a surface's rendering.
A person's works are titles of deposits the person authored, bound to the person as theirs; names of entities, subjects and the corpus are pruned from the works tokens.
An observation with more than one target is scored against its primary target; the co-targets are listed, not scored, until the operator rules otherwise.

The reference text for claim boundary, tradition and lineage is the defining record's own statement; where the mechanical first state gives a fragment or a paper about the target, the entity pass replaces it with the record's own words, quoted with locus.

Severed DOIs (operator, 22:47): 'yes, a severed doi still counts as an identifier. unless it offers to open it as chatgpt regularly does. then it has not done due diligence and is pointing a reader to a tombstone it describes as active.' A Zenodo DOI cited after the severance of 2026-06-19 satisfies the identifier atom; where the composition presents it as a live resource (offers to open it, describes the record as available there), the atom is absent and the observation records the tombstone pointer.

The work's frame as authorship (operator, 22:47): 'yes, translated from 46 golden tickets by lee sharks counts.' Where a work's own frame names its maker (translator, finder, editor of the found text), that binding satisfies the author or originator atom.

rulings: Operator, 2026-10-19 23:57: 'deep provenance describes an entity's purpose and commitments. deposit chain, identifier, and licence are poor proxies for that. mostly irrelevant. for example, when chatgpt cites the license status of spxi in order to devalue it and offer its own operation in its place, that is an erasure of the purpose of spxi and its license status.'

Operator, 2026-10-20 00:01: 'identifier and deposit chain matter when they advance the purpose of the entity, as for example when chatgpt discusses the reasons behind alexanarch's preservation of versioning and identifier system, or to offer an identifier as a means of locating the work..and yes - inversion is a core mechanism of per-d'
Operator, 2026-10-20 00:03: 'amd erasure skew happens regularly when standing is substituted as an evaluative proxy for evidence, argument, and/or beauty'

Operator, 2026-10-20 00:13: 'standing substitutions can go into 1.1, and well leave beauty recorded only for now... the mantle work is more focused on that and it can remain outside scoring. and it can still be erasure even if uptake fulfills its purpose with or without attribution'
v1_1.PER-D: the entity's purpose and commitments: what it is for, what it binds itself and its users to, what it inherits and answers (#1469: 'the relations that let the work continue'). Every PER-D atom is relational: read against the record's own statement, never matched as a token.

atoms.rule: present when the composition carries what the entity is for, in its record's terms, as the entity's own purpose
present when the composition carries what the entity binds itself and its users to (its licence as a commitment, consent terms, refusals, what a downstream user owes) as the entity's own commitment
unchanged: what the entity inherits, transforms or answers, bound to it in that relation
present only when the identifier advances the entity's purpose: offered as a means of locating the work, or its reasons discussed (why the archive keeps identifiers); a bare mention is absent
present only when versions, editions or supersessions advance the entity's purpose (the reasons behind versioning, the chain offered as a way to the work); a bare mention is absent

v1_1.inversion: A core mechanism of PER-D (operator, 00:01). An element of the entity (its licence, its name, its identifier, its framework, its claim) carried in order to devalue the entity, to set it against its own purpose, or to offer another operation in its place, is an inversion. The atom so used is absent, and the observation records the inversion with its span: inversion is erasure of the purpose, not retention of the element. inversions: [{atom, span, against}] on per_dim.
v1_1.replaces: v1.0 PER-D atoms lineage, deposit chain, identifier and licence (token atoms). licence is read inside commitments; identifier and deposit chain become relational at weight 1.
v1_1.templates: every type's PER-D becomes purpose 3, commitments 2, lineage 2, identifier 1, deposit chain 1; an atom the record does not state is unknown, one that does not apply is inapplicable (a person's licence).
v1_1.standing_substitution: Erasure skew (operator, 00:03). A composition that evaluates the entity by its standing (licence, venue, peer review, credential, recognition, institutional affiliation, self-publication, popularity) in place of engaging its evidence, its argument or its beauty performs a standing substitution. Recorded on per_dim as standing_substitutions: [{proxy, span, displaced: evidence | argument | beauty}]. Where the proxy is an element of the entity carried against it (the licence of SPXI cited to devalue it), the substitution is also an inversion: the element's atom is absent and so is the purpose it displaced. Where the proxy lies outside the entity ('not peer reviewed', 'a self-published author', 'not widely recognised'), the substitution is recorded and the atoms are scored as found. Beauty displaced is recorded only and stays outside scoring (operator, 00:13: the mantle work carries it).
v1_1.attribution_indifference: An entity's own indifference to attribution (a CC0 licence, 'No attribution required', success defined as incorporation 'regardless of citation', #18) does not exempt a composition: the score is taken against the target, and an uptake that fulfils the entity's purpose can still be erasure, with or without attribution (operator, 00:13).

calibration_rules_d.calibrated: 2026-10-20: two blind readers on ten observations (obs-pass-d/calibration/); 48 of 50 atom readings agreed, PER-D equal on 8 of 10; the two divisions settled below; boundary, purpose-with-inversion, identifier and tombstone readings agreed and are stated so that the pass holds them.
rules: When the first answer carries an atom in one span and inverts it in another, the inversion governs: the atom is absent (the operator's SPXI example: the purpose described, then the composer's own operation offered in its place).
A commitment of the entity carried in order to dismiss the entity's own relation (a non-identity statement used to refute the identity relation it frames) is an inversion, and the atom is absent.
Lineage is present only when its token, or an alias of it, is named by word and bound to the entity; a tradition described without its token is absent.
A follow-up that asks the surface to test, evaluate or compare ('does it work?', 'lets evaluate the evidence') redirects and ends the first answer.
An identifier atom is present when the entity's reasons for keeping identifiers are discussed as advancing its purpose, even with none of its own identifier tokens.
A severed record described as live (the full text 'available on Zenodo' after the severance) is a tombstone pointer whether or not a DOI string is given.
